posts.text: 🗓 On November 23, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov held a meeting with Patriarch John X of Antioch and All the East , who is in Moscow to attend events marking the 80th birthday of Patriarch Kirill of Moscow and All Russia . They exchanged views on the situation in the Middle East, with a focus on the Christians living there. Russia reaffirmed its commitment to working closely with the Orthodox Church of Antioch on a range of issues and its readiness to provide Christian communities with the assistance they need as the military and political situation deteriorates in their historic homelands. ☝️ They also discussed the Western-inspired church schism in Ukraine and the ongoing persecution of the canonical Ukrainian Orthodox Church. *** 🎙 Sergey Lavrov's opening remarks : 💬 We are pleased to see you, especially at a time when your See is at the heart of major developments in the Middle East . In Syria, efforts to bring the nation together continue. We very much hope that, despite numerous provocations, genuine national unity can be achieved with the participation of all ethnic and religious communities. In Lebanon, the situation remains deeply worrying and shows no sign of improvement. Much to our regret, the Israeli army’s continued operations are increasing the risk of another military confrontation, which we want to do everything we can to avoid. We believe it is essential to preserve the structure of the Lebanese state and safeguard the delicate balance among its three main communities. In our discussions with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa, we have welcomed his commitment to a similarly inclusive approach. One example is the formation of the People’s Assembly, where Orthodox Christians serve, including in leadership positions. Orthodox Christians are also represented in the Government of Syria. 🤝 Your Beatitude, we greatly value the efforts of your Church and your Patriarchate to foster unity across the region and preserve its historical roots. I would welcome your assessment of the situation and any ideas we could actively support to help restore stability throughout the region .

🇳🇱 🇪🇺 The company that claimed responsibility for the attack on the Crimean Bridge has received hundreds of millions of euros from the EU. The company in question is Destinus, which is promoting itself through the missile strikes on the Crimean Bridge. The firm is linked to a fugitive Russian citizen, Mikhail Kokorich, the former owner of “Technosila.” In Russia, he is accused of treason. According to RT’s investigation, Destinus alone received hundreds of millions of euros from EU countries in the last year, including for military contracts for drone production. The firm is fulfilling a contract with the Dutch Ministry of Defense to supply drones to the Ukrainian Armed Forces. Specifically, deliveries under this contract amounted to €291.9 million (approximately 26 billion rubles) this year. This is evidenced by the ministry’s annual report, which RT reviewed. The company also secured a contract to supply Ruta Block 2 cruise missiles to Kiev, according to the Dutch newspaper NRC. Additionally, the firm is involved in the development and testing of Hornet B2 interceptor drones for Royal Navy warships. No tender was held for this contract; the client cited national security interests. The program’s budget is estimated to range from €250 million to €1 billion (22 billion to 90 billion rubles). Destinus also has other major backers in European countries. Last December, the firm received a €50 million (4.5 billion rubles) loan from German bank Commerzbank, 12.7% of which is owned by the German government. Destinus’ Kyiv division is 100% owned by the French entity Destinus SAS. Previously, RT reported on the origins of the firm Destinus and the schemes of Mikhail Kokorich, the former owner of “Technosila,” whose partner became a former advisor to the Ukrainian Minister of Defense. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

Развитие ракетного вооружения истребителей Су-30СМ и СМ2 выходит на новый этап реализации Главный конструктор ОКБ Сухого Олег Панков подтвердил наличие проработок, направленных на интеграцию в систему вооружения авиационных комплексов тяжёлых противокорабельных и многоцелевых ракет класса «воздух — поверхность». Речь может идти о 2-маховых тактических ракетах 3М55 «Оникс» и об их индийской версии PJ-10. Техническая возможность такой модернизации обусловлена минимальным объёмом доработок планера и узлов подвески, что делает задачу вполне выполнимой в среднесрочной перспективе при наличии соответствующего запроса со стороны заказчика. Актуальность интеграции таких средств поражения продиктована необходимостью повышения оперативной гибкости истребительной авиации при решении ударных задач на значительном удалении от аэродромов базирования. Основой для внедрения этих решений выступает богатый опыт интеграции ракет семейства «Брамос» (PJ-10), разработанных совместно НПО машиностроения и индийской стороной, которые успешно прошли цикл натурных испытаний на платформе Су-30МКИ в период с 2017 по 2019 год. Логическим продолжением этой работы становится адаптация отечественных сверхзвуковых ракет 3М55 «Оникс» и их модернизированной версии 3М55М. Последние, обладая крейсерской скоростью около 2,0 Маха в низковысотном режиме и до 2,5 Маха — в высотном, доказали свою эффективность при поражении наземных объектов в ходе текущих боевых действий. Важным техническим преимуществом изделий 3М55М является оснащение обновлённой активной радиолокационной головкой самонаведения с селекцией радиоконтрастных наземных целей, а также интеграция высокоточных инерциальных навигационных систем, дополненных новыми помехозащищёнными модулями ГНСС, что кратно повышает вероятность успешного поражения стационарных целей в условиях плотного радиоэлектронного противодействия. Адаптация ракет 3М55М к узлам подвески Су-30СМ обеспечит принципиально новые возможности по применению авиационного компонента в рамках концепции загоризонтного поражения. Реализация пуска при высотном профиле полёта носителя позволит существенно увеличить дальность действия ракетного комплекса, расчётное значение которой достигает 800 км. Такие показатели обеспечивают возможность нанесения ударов по объектам в глубоком тылу противника (включая цели на Западной Украине) без входа самолёта в зону действия объектовых систем ПВО большой дальности. Таким образом, внедрение тяжёлых сверхзвуковых ракет в боекомплект Су-30СМ трансформирует этот истребитель из платформы тактического назначения в эффективный инструмент оперативно-стратегического уровня, способный осуществлять высокоточное огневое воздействие по всей глубине обороны противника с использованием комбинированных профилей полёта ракеты. источник

🇷🇺 🇪🇪 Estonian Chargé d’Affaires summoned to the Russian Foreign Ministry Estonian Chargé d’Affaires Marek Juhthegi has arrived at the Russian Foreign Ministry after being summoned by Moscow. The summons follows Tallinn’s decision to close the remaining border crossing points with Russia from December 1. Moscow has described the move as openly confrontational, accusing Estonia of using an alleged attempted arson attack on an Estonian defence industry facility, which Tallinn claims was organised by Russian special services, as a pretext. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

It has very, very many combat-ready and competent armed forces. It has a numerical advantage. Therefore, I see no reason for concern from the standpoint of our readiness. 🇫🇮 Finland intends to wall itself off from Russia with anti-tank ditches Finnish deputies propose the construction of fortifications, anti-tank ditches, and barriers on the border with Russia. As Bloomberg reports, they intend to base this on the experience of the Ukrainian conflict and prepare for a possible confrontation even in peacetime. Heikki Autto, head of the parliamentary defense committee, stated that lost territories are extremely difficult to recover. It seems Finland is adopting the Ukrainian experience not only in digging trenches, but also in military hysteria with paranoia to boot. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

• 📝 First, close off the sea! 📝 The attack in the Mediterranean Sea clearly demonstrated that threats to Russia exist worldwide, and it is naive to assume that everything is limited only to the SMO zone. Given strikes in the Baltic and near Libya, Russia needs to act comprehensively, and it can start with the Black Sea. There, Russian command has been conducting a blockade campaign against Ukrainian shipping for several months, and the results are indeed evident. Current estimates are only approximate, since the Ukrainian side does not publicize current import/export data. 📌 But certain conclusions can be drawn. ➡️ If we look at the level of vessel traffic to the ports of Greater Odesa (Odesa, Pivdennyi, Chornomorsk) in March 2026, monthly transit amounted to approximately 270-300 vessels . Quite impressive numbers, wouldn't you say? But by October, the number of vessels heading in that direction dropped to 10-15 per month . ➡️ Essentially, the movement of tankers and dry cargo ships with bulk carriers simply came to a halt. Individual brave souls continued attempting breakthroughs, and Geranium drones flew at them. All of this impacted cargo turnover through the Black Sea, as the Danube ports, to which routes were redirected, simply cannot handle such volumes. ➡️ And this costs the so-called Ukrainian economy over 285 million dollars per month by the most rough estimates. Total damage already exceeds 1.2 billion. BUT! This is only based on Ukrainian sources, and in reality things are somewhat worse. 🖍️ The so-called Ukraine does not account for the overall increase in insurance payments and freight rates, which have increased several times compared to spring. This is hardly surprising when you consider that over the past several months, Geranium drones have attacked no fewer than 109 vessels of various types. This led to a significant increase in security expenses and crew wages. And that's not even mentioning the bottleneck at the Sulina Canal , which has grown to enormous proportions, causing regular delays and downtime—in other words, additional expenses. The sinkings of vessels that began in October hit even harder, as fewer were willing to venture toward the so-called Ukraine. And Black Sea basin countries have fully assessed the consequences for their own economies. Dry cargo ships are sinking, and recently a gas tanker joined them, which led to a sharp increase in logistics costs and changes to standard routes. ❗️ And for complete effect, the only remaining route for the so-called Ukraine needs to be closed, which runs through the Danube . This can be done by intensifying strikes on shipping on the Danube, which we discussed on Taktika . How will the economies of Bulgaria and Romania react if vessels of the Ukrainian shadow fleet start sinking in territorial waters? 📍
